verdict.rationale: Browserbase docs say agents can be deployed and run 'on a schedule or on demand' [browserbase-docs-14]. This is supported by continuous monitoring and change-tracking use cases [browserbase-docs-11, browserbase-docs-12] and by webhooks that notify on run events without polling [browserbase-docs-19]. However, the scheduling capability rests on a single one-line claim with no detail. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, timezones, managing or pausing schedules via API/SDK), retry/failure handling for recurring runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
